Name: Tox's Velociraptor Chickens
Author: toxicToxophilite
Description:
Introducing velociraptors! Why have regular boring chickens when you can have prehistoric chickens instead? It's a win-win for everyone, as even dinos need love and these guys are ready to come to your farm and get some.

While my mod isn't the first to introduce the raptor sprites as chickens, I did add all new baby sprites and hand-color brand new textures onto them. If you want a more thorough velociraptor experience, I recommend downloading Morgrim's mod and replacing their chicken textures with mine, as mine only handles the main farm birds. The only thing you'll lose out on is the chickens being named "Velociraptor" in game.

Original Velociraptor sprites: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/825]Zynonia[/url]
Raptor Chicken concept: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3461]Morgrim
[/url]Color inspiration: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8253]Kanafile[/url]
